messages:
Omar (oncall): trying to promote canary -> prod but deploy-bot rejected me: 'MFA required for role=prod-deployer' even though I'm on the deploy rota. anyone seen this?

deploy-bot: Request denied — user not in 'prod-deployer' group. To proceed, run `/request-elev` or contact infra. See https://go/release-ops for policies.

Maria Li: did you get a JIT earlier? those expire after 1h by default.

Omar (oncall): I requested a JIT ~45m ago, should still be valid. /whoami shows: groups: [oncall, infra-read]. no prod-deployer.

Infra-SRE: quick check — run: `./scripts/check-deploy-roles.sh omar` and `aws sts get-caller-identity` to confirm identity. SCIM sync has been flaky lately.

Jen Park: i hit this at 04:10 UTC too. SCIM job failed during the overnight sync, looked like a mapping for the Okta group 'redwood-prod-deployers' got dropped.

Kelsey (security): confirmed — SCIM sync error flagged at 03:58. mapping for group 'redwood-prod-deployers' was unset during a policy cleanup. reapplying mapping now, patch rolling. will post when complete.

Omar (oncall): thanks. i used `/request-elev` as a fallback and got temporary sudo for this push, but we should avoid relying on that for normal promotions. can we have an automatic fallback for oncall? e.g., if oncall group + active rota, grant ephemeral deployer for 30m.

Maria Li: filing INFRA-4321 to evaluate a 30m grace window for oncall during SCIM outages. also adding a short blurb to the release notes: "deploy permissions - temporary oncall elevation gap; using `/request-elev` workaround" :memo:

deploy-bot: Elevation request logged (INFRA-4321). Reminder: emergency rollback command: `/deploy rollback --to 2026-03-20T02:00Z`

Samir Patel: thx for the quick triage team :thumbsup:

Kelsey (security): SCIM mapping applied. please re-check group membership in 2m and retest.

Omar (oncall): confirmed — now in prod-deployer group. can promote. closing this thread after the infra ticket lands.

Maria Li: leaving follow-up in INFRA-4321 with action items: (1) add monitoring alert for SCIM mapping drops, (2) document fallback policy for oncall, (3) consider ephemeral grace period.

deploy-bot: Thread closed by deploy-bot (automated) — ticket INFRA-4321 created.
